question: A 25% profit is made when a discount of 25% is given on the marked price of an item. When the discount is 35%, what will be the profit? (Give your answer correct to the nearest whole number.)
solution:
**Given:**

Profit = 25 %

Discount = 25 %

**Concept Used:**

S.P = C.P + Profit

S.P = M.P – Discount

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the cost price be Rs. 100

⇒ There is a profit of 25 % on the item

⇒ So, Selling price = 100 + 25% of 100

⇒ Selling Price = 100+ (25)/(100) × 100 = 125 Rs.

⇒ Also, S.P = M. P – Discount

⇒ Discount = 25 % of M.P 

⇒ S.P = M.P – 25 % of M.P

⇒ 125 = M.P – frac {25}{100} × M.P

⇒ 125 = (3)/(4) M.P

⇒ M.P = 4 × 125 over 3

⇒ M.P = Rs. (500)/(3)

⇒ Now, there is a discount of 35 % on M.P

⇒ New S.P = M.P – 35 % of M.P

⇒ New S.P = frac{500} {3} - frac {35}{100} × frac {500}{3}=(500)/(3)-(175)/(3)

⇒ New S.P = Rs. (325)/(3) 

⇒ Hence Profit = (325)/(3)-100=(325-300)/(3)=(25)/(3)

⇒ Profit % = 8 (1)/(3) ≈ 8 %

 **Hence we can say that profit percent is equivalent to 8 %**
